**Supported Operating Systems**

| Operating System | Supported Versions |
| --- | --- |
| Red Hat\* Enterprise Linux\* (RHEL) | 9 |
| SUSE Linux\* Enterprise Server | 15 SP5 |
| Ubuntu\* | 20.04, 22.04, 24.04 |

**Memory**

A minimum of 64 GB of system memory is required.

**Quartus® Prime Software**

Quartus® Prime software is required for Altera® HLS IP Gen compilation. Different target devices require different editions of the software.

_Quartus® Prime Pro Edition 26.1_ is required for the following devices:

- Agilex™ 3
- Agilex™ 5
- Agilex™ 7
- Arria® 10
- Stratix® 10
- Cyclone® 10 GX

_Quartus® Prime Standard Edition 25.1_ is required for the following device:

- Cyclone® V

**Simulation Prerequisites**

_Questa\*-Altera® FPGA and Starter Editions_ or _Siemens\* QuestaSim\*_ is required for Altera® HLS IP Gen simulation compilation.

```
ahls -Xshardware -Xstarget="<​FPGA device family or part number>"...
```

5. **Integrate your IP into a system with Quartus® Prime or Platform Designer.**
For details, refer to [Integrating Your RTL IP Core Into a System](https://docs.altera.com/r/~l7TEUAnDx9Ve02N~HACRQ/SD_8ewW5OWFWfrB02U1P1Q).
